name: Tempester n°4b: compressor envelope sent on every beat selection
explanation: The four parameters of the compressor envelope (Attack, Peak Hold, Decay, Amount, bytes +0x2d to +0x30 of the beat) were sent to Voice chip 3 (commands 0xdf00, 0xe000, 0xe100, 0xe200) only from the edit screen: at startup and on every beat change, the chip kept other values (« displayed right, no effect until you touch them », forum, paraphrased). The voice initialization in main (loop 0xb4..0xde, [address]) does not cover them either. Hook at the entry of [routine], which already applies BPM, Swing, Compression and Distortion of the current beat on every selection/load: the added code (0x9d07b100) sends the four values through [routine](value|command, 3), like the edit screen, then replays the original prologue. [routine] is reached only by the interface state machine ([routine], started at [address] after the voice initialization); it already called [routine] (through [routine], depending on the Distortion source), which disables interrupts during the transfer.

edits.why: j 0x9d07b100 ; hook: entry of [routine] (settings of the current beat, called on every beat selection/load) to the added code
nop ; jump delay slot ; the original instruction (sw s1,0x14(sp)) is replayed at 0x9d07b180
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; 0x20 frame ; 0x0-0xf left to [routine] (o32 argument area)
lw t0,0x13c(a0) ; index of the current beat (ctx+0x13c), like [address] in [routine]
addu s0,t0,t1 ; s0 = current beat ([address] + n*0x294)
ori a0,a0,0xdf00 ; Attack (beat+0x2d) | 0xdf00, same command as the edit screen
li a1,0x3 ; Voice chip 3 (the one that receives the envelope trigger 0xef00)
ori a0,a0,0xe200 ; Amount (beat+0x30) | 0xe200 (like [address] ; the 0x3f clamp of the editor is unchanged)
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; original prologue of [routine] replayed
j [address] ; return into [routine] after the two moved instructions
sw s1,0x14(sp) ; original instruction of [address], in the jump delay slot
